steps.code:
# Fetch detailed info for each playlist to get songs.
all_songs = {}  # song_id -> set of artist_ids (deduplicate songs across playlists)
for pl in all_playlists:
    pl_detail = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pl['playlist_id'], access_token=access_token)
    for song in pl_detail['songs']:
        sid = song['id']
        if sid not in all_songs:
            all_songs[sid] = set(song['artist_ids'])
        else:
            # merge artist ids (though same song should have same artists, but just in case)
            all_songs[sid].update(song['artist_ids'])

print(f"Unique songs: {len(all_songs)}")
# Show a sample
sample = list(all_songs.items())[:3]
print(sample)

# Count songs per artist (each song counted once per artist).
from collections import defaultdict

artist_song_count = defaultdict(int)
for song_id, artists in all_songs.items():
    for aid in artists:
        artist_song_count[aid] += 1

# Build list of (count, artist_name) and sort by count then name
artist_count_list = [(count, artist_names[aid]) for aid, count in artist_song_count.items()]
artist_count_list.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))

# Take the 4 with the least songs
least_4 = artist_count_list[:4]
